examples.arabic: ذهبت الى السوق الكبير لاشتري ملابس جديدة للصيف
examples.english: I went to the large market to buy new clothes for the summer.
examples.transliteration: dhahabtu ila al suq al kabir li ashtari malabis jadida lil sayf

examples.arabic: اذهب الى السوق مع عائلتي لشراء ملابس
examples.english: I go to the market with my family to buy clothes.
examples.transliteration: adhhab ila alsouq ma'a aa'ilatee lishiraa malaabis

examples.arabic: ذهب الأصدقاء إلى متجر كبير لشراء ملابس جديدة
examples.english: The friends went to a large store to buy new clothes.
examples.transliteration: dhahaba al asdiqa ila matjar kabir lishira malabis jadida

examples.english: Sami went to the clothing store.

examples.arabic: ذهبت ليلى الى السوق مساء لشراء ملابس جديدة
examples.english: Layla went to the market in the evening to buy new clothes.
examples.transliteration: Dhahabat Layla ila as-sooqi masaa'an li-shira'i malabis jadeedah.
